messages:
alex: Heads-up — seeing a pattern from EU edge (edge-eu-2): clients hit what looks like a "soft" timeout, proxy sends FIN, client reopens and immediately resends init -> double logical sessions and duplicate billing counts. Not huge but consistent spike over last 30m.

maria: Ugh. Any examples of the logs or status codes?

alex: Log excerpt:
```
edge-eu-2 | conn=abcd1234 state=HALF_CLOSE last_activity=2026-03-22T14:32:10Z
proxy    | sent FIN idle_grace=15s upstream=ok
client   | onclose code=1001 then reconnect
server   | received init token=tok_9f3a, processed
server   | received init token=tok_9f3a (again) -> created new session
```

cheng: Sounds like proxy idle_grace -> FIN, clients treat as terminal. Our resume flow expects a soft close (keep-alive or explicit header) so it does full reconnect rather than resume. Do we have resume-idempotency?

alex: Not for duplicate inits right now. If the client reconnects fast enough the server treats it as a brand new session.

dena: We could change proxy behavior to send a short text-close or special header before FIN so clients attempt resume instead of full reconnect, but browser WS close semantics are limited. Another quicker fix is to make the init path idempotent server-side for ~60s.

maria: Quick mitigation = dedupe on init token for short window (60s) + console flag to mark these as "soft-reconnects" in telemetry. Longer term we should revisit proxy semantics.

cheng: Agree. Also add metric stream.sessions.duplicate_init and a Grafana panel. We need alerting: >50 dup_inits/min in a region should trigger an ops page.

alex: I'll open a small PR to accept duplicate inits for 60s and add an emitted metric. Patching now to canary in eu-2.

dena: I'll own the RFC for proxy close semantics (browser compat + backend hinting). Will add notes about sending SSE-style header before FIN? (might not survive proxies.)

deploy-bot: Deployment started: alex/stream-init-dedupe -> canary edge-eu-2 :rocket:

maria: Watch for CPU increase — duplicate session churn can spike CPU. If cpu>10% we disable canary autoscale and roll back.

alex: Canary rolling. Will post quick telemetry after 5m.

alex: (5m) initial canary shows a 1200% increase in duplicate_init metric for the canary servers, but downstream billing already shows only a transient blip. Deduped requests are short-circuited.

maria: Good. Keep an eye on latency and memory.

alex: (10m) stabilizing. duplicate_init peaked then dropped to baseline. No sustained billing anomaly.

maria: Nice. Follow-ups: (1) add dashboard tile for duplicate_init by region (cheng) (2) RFC for proxy close semantics (dena) (3) console annotation flag for soft-close events + alert (alex to add).

dena: RFC created: https://go/redwood/rfc/proxy-soft-close (notes added about browser close codes and fallback).

alex: Thanks everyone. I'll promote the patch to rolling once churn stays <1% for 30m.

maria: Also please add a short runbook entry — how to detect vs. terminal closes and what to do (rollback, trace correlate with edge node). I'll write the alert text. :+1:

cheng: I'll add the Grafana panel and an annotation for the next deploy window.

alex: Closing thread when rolling completes — will ping if anything odd.
